class.name: HalfEdgeMesh
class.brief_description: Editable half-edge surface mesh with n-gon support and mesh conversion helpers.
class.description: [HalfEdgeMesh] stores polygonal surface topology using a half-edge representation while exposing a script-friendly API. Faces may contain any number of vertices, so the structure can represent triangles, quads, and larger n-gons. When built from standard triangle mesh arrays or a [Mesh] surface, adjacent coplanar triangles are merged automatically and the same pass continues merging adjacent coplanar quads or larger polygons when the resulting face stays planar and simple. The generated mesh export triangulates each face back to standard Godot mesh arrays and computes averaged vertex normals from the stored faces.

method.name: add_face
method.description: Adds a face using the provided vertex indices and returns its index. Faces must be planar and contain at least three unique vertices.

method.name: add_vertex
method.description: Adds a vertex position and returns the new vertex index.

method.name: add_box
method.description: Appends a box centered on the origin, transformed by [param transform]. Returns a dictionary with [code]vertices[/code] and [code]faces[/code] listing the appended indices.

method.name: add_cylinder
method.description: Appends a cylinder aligned to the local Y axis. The side wall is built from quads, while the top and bottom are n-gon faces. Returns a dictionary with [code]vertices[/code] and [code]faces[/code] listing the appended indices.

method.name: add_icosphere
method.description: Appends an icosphere made entirely of triangle faces. Each subdivision step splits every triangle into four smaller triangles before projection back to the sphere radius. Returns a dictionary with [code]vertices[/code] and [code]faces[/code] listing the appended indices.

method.name: add_uv_sphere
method.description: Appends a UV sphere aligned to the local Y axis. The intermediate latitude bands are quads, while the poles use triangle fans so the surface stays spherical under planar face validation. Returns a dictionary with [code]vertices[/code] and [code]faces[/code] listing the appended indices.

method.name: build_from_arrays
method.description: Builds the half-edge mesh from standard [Mesh] arrays. Only the vertex and index arrays are used, and the source data is expected to describe triangles.

method.name: build_from_mesh
method.description: Builds the half-edge mesh from one triangle surface of [param mesh], automatically merging adjacent coplanar faces into larger polygons when possible.

method.name: build_from_triangle_arrays
method.description: Builds the half-edge mesh from triangle vertices and optional indices. If [param indices] is empty, [param vertices] is read as consecutive triangle triplets.

method.name: bevel
method.description: Performs a zero-offset topological bevel on the selected full edges. Each selected edge must be an interior manifold edge. The operation duplicates every connected selected-edge endpoint once per incident face, rewrites those incident faces to the duplicates, creates one new face per selected vertex, and creates one new quad per selected edge. Returns a dictionary with [code]edge_faces[/code], [code]vertex_faces[/code], and [code]replaced_faces[/code].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all vertices, faces, and derived half-edge topology.

method.name: compact_vertices
method.description: Removes vertices that are no longer referenced by any face and remaps the remaining topology.

method.name: cut
method.description: Cuts the requested face with a closed loop of ordered 2D points in that face's local projection space. The cut loop becomes a new inner face, while the original face is replaced by the clipped remainder polygons. All cut points must lie inside the target face and every segment, including the implicit last-to-first segment, must stay inside the face boundary. Returns the indices of the faces produced by the operation.

method.name: extrude
method.description: Extrudes the requested face along its normal by [param distance], creating a new top face and one quad side face per boundary edge. Returns the indices of the created faces.

method.name: get_collinear_epsilon
method.description: Returns the tolerance used when simplifying merged polygons by removing collinear vertices.

method.name: get_coplanar_epsilon
method.description: Returns the tolerance used when checking whether adjacent faces can be merged.

method.name: get_edge_data
method.description: Returns a dictionary containing [code]halfedge[/code], [code]vertices[/code], and [code]boundary[/code] for the requested edge.

method.name: get_face_data
method.description: Returns a dictionary containing [code]halfedge[/code], [code]plane[/code], [code]normal[/code], and [code]vertices[/code] for the requested face.

method.name: get_face_projection
method.description: Returns the local 2D projection basis for the requested face. The dictionary contains [code]origin[/code], [code]tangent[/code], [code]bitangent[/code], [code]normal[/code], and [code]vertices[/code], where [code]vertices[/code] is the current face loop projected into that basis. Use this coordinate space when providing points to [method cut].

method.name: get_faces
method.description: Returns the stored polygon faces as an array of [PackedInt32Array] values.

method.name: get_halfedge_data
method.description: Returns a dictionary containing [code]origin[/code], [code]destination[/code], [code]face[/code], [code]edge[/code], [code]next[/code], [code]prev[/code], [code]twin[/code], and [code]boundary[/code] for the requested half-edge.

method.name: set_faces
method.description: Replaces the mesh with the provided explicit polygon faces. Each face entry must be a [PackedInt32Array] or an array of integers.

method.name: to_mesh
method.description: Triangulates the stored faces and returns them as a single-surface [ArrayMesh].

method.name: to_mesh_arrays
method.description: Triangulates the stored faces and returns standard [Mesh] arrays containing vertices, normals, and indices.

members.member: Tolerance used when simplifying merged polygon loops by removing collinear vertices.
Tolerance used when deciding whether adjacent faces lie on the same plane.
